title: Chrono24 Metric0 High Value Outliers
dataSources: Chrono24 listings (`chrono24:listing`), WatchBox service records (`watchbox:service`), wrist-time logs (`watch:wristtime`), and watch service history (`watch:service`).
app: Chrono24 listing snapshots, WatchBox service records, wrist-time wear logs, and in-house service history exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=chrono24:metric0 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in chrono24 metric0 events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme chrono24 metric0 records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It works out the unusually high or low value moments in your chrono24 metric0 history.
